description: Refactor the procedural metrics-ingest module pipeline.py into a Pipeline class with explicit __init__ state, typed methods and a @property read-only view, while the module-level wrappers keep delegating to a shared default instance; the gate drives the public API and the CLI and must stay green before and after.

criteria: pipeline.py is rebuilt around a Pipeline class that holds its counters, per-source tally, record log and sequence number in __init__, exposes the tally as a fresh-copy @property view, carries type hints on every signature and leaves no module-level mutable state, while process_record, replay, summarize and reset remain as wrappers over a shared default instance and the gate confirming the exact rejection reasons, sequence numbers, per-source attribution, summary shape, reset semantics and CLI output and exit codes still exits 0.
